title.narrative: Support to Tunisia's Maritime Border Control and Management

description.narrative: This project aims to contribute to enhanced maritime border security in Tunisia and to reduce irregular and dangerous migration attempts, thereby minimising loss of life in the Mediterranean Sea. The objective is to strengthen the capacities of the Tunisian Ministry of Interior, speci?cally of the Maritime National Guard, to monitor national maritime borders, prevent and stop irregular migration attempts, in compliance with human rights standards and international humanitarian law. UNOPS supports these objectives through procurement support for search and rescue vessels, border security equipment, and comprehensive training.\n
